OEM Product Portfolio

Precision Forged & Machined Components

High-fidelity B2B manufacturing. We do not sell from stock; we develop components to customer specifications and engineering drawings.

Bearing Rings, Races, Thrust Washers & Lock Nuts

Our flagship manufacturing line serving bearing manufacturers. We produce seamless rolled rings ready for grinding or turning processes, maintaining strict grain flow alignment to maximize bearing fatigue life.

Technical Details:

Products Inner/Outer Bearing Races, Clutch Bearing Rings, Thrust Washers, Lock & Groove Nuts
Material Steel Grades SAE 52100 (High Carbon Chrome bearing steel), Carbon Steel, Case Hardening Alloys
Size & Weight Range OD: 50 mm to 450 mm (0.500 Kg to 20 Kg per component)
Manufacturing Process Shearing → Induction Heating → Press Punching → Ring Rolling → Spheroidize Annealing → Rough Machining
Applications Deep groove ball bearings, tapered roller bearings, clutch release assemblies
Industries Served Bearing manufacturers, Automotive OEMs, Industrial Gearbox makers
Request Bearing Component RFQ

Precision Bearing Inner & Outer Races

Finished or semi-machined bearing steel rings showing optimal spheriodized microstructure.

Seamless Rolled Rings & Custom Flanges

Using modern radial-axial ring rolling mills, we manufacture seamless rings with clean geometry, minimal machining allowances, and high material yields compared to hammer forgings.

Technical Details:

Products Seamless Rolled Rings, Gear Ring Blanks, Large Spacers, Custom Flanges
Material Steel Grades Low, Medium, High Carbon & Alloy Steels (SAE1008 to SAE52100, 20MnCr5, 16MnCr5, SAE8620, SAE4140, EN353)
Size & Weight Range OD: 50 mm to 450 mm (0.200 Kg to 20.000 Kg per piece)
Manufacturing Process Induction billet heating → Ring rolling → Normalizing/Annealing → CNC Turning
Applications Industrial gears, slewing rings, pipe fittings, heavy valves
Industries Served Heavy Engineering, Hydraulics, Power Transmission, Oil & Gas
Request Ring Rolling RFQ

Seamless Rolled Ring Blanks

Rolled shapes showing smooth surface finish and close tolerances to reduce final machining time.

Automotive Forgings (Gear Blanks, Hubs, Axles & Custom Parts)

Our closed die forging facility is fully optimized for passenger cars, utility vehicles, agricultural tractors, and earth-moving gearboxes. Parts are supplied as-forged or precision turned.

Technical Details:

Products Gear Blanks, Clutch Hubs, Axle Hubs, Brake Drums, Connecting Rods, Forge Pins, Steering Knuckles
Material Steel Grades Carbon Steel (EN8D, EN9, C45), Alloy Steels (20MnCr5, 16MnCr5, SAE8620, SAE4140, EN353, EN19)
Size & Weight Range Die Size: 650 # 350 # 250 mm (0.500 Kg to 20 Kg weight range)
Manufacturing Process Closed Die Drop Hammer Forging → Isothermal Annealing → CNC turning → Keyway VMC milling
Applications Transmission gear systems, differential assemblies, steering joints
Industries Served Automotive, Agriculture, Material Handling, Power Transmission
Request Automotive Forging RFQ

Precision Machined Automotive Hubs

Finished transmission and wheel hub components ready for assembly line operations.

Drawing-Based Custom Forgings & OEM Developments

With in-house engineering and tooling software, we specialize in developing custom-designed closed die forgings. Send us your mockups, 2D drawings, or 3D STEP files for direct prototyping.

Technical Details:

Products Custom Valves, Structural Flanges, Hydraulic Bushings, Mechanical Seal Rings, Specialty Spacers
Material Steel Grades Carbon, Medium Carbon, Alloys, and Stainless Steels (SS304, SS316L, SS410)
Size & Weight Range Press Size: 150 # 150 # 80 (0.100 Kg to 2 Kg weight range)
Manufacturing Process Die Simulation → Prototyping → Hammer/Press Forging → Heat treatment → Finished turning
Applications High-pressure valves, machinery joints, hydraulic cylinders, custom couplings
Industries Served Hydraulics, Oil & Gas, Construction Equipment, OEM Machinery makers
